name: Upper-Trapezius Neck Stretch

instructions.description: Sit or stand tall with shoulders relaxed.
Tilt one ear gently toward the same-side shoulder.
Keep the chin facing forward and breathe comfortably.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Use a consistent reviewer-defined quality scale for control and alignment.

variations.variationDescription: Upper-Trapezius Neck Stretch — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.

commentsNotes: Use only light head weight; do not pull forcefully.
